findings.highlight: I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.
findings.evidenceJa: アゾット剣を布で覆い、脇に抱える。
findings.governingReading: He wraps Azoth in cloth and carries it under or beside his arm.
findings.explanation: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.

findings.highlight: "Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「いってらっしゃいシロウ。夜が明ける頃に、サクラとリンと三人で帰ってきてね」
findings.governingReading: Illya asks him to return with Sakura and Rin around when night gives way to dawn.

findings.highlight: When I fell asleep here, sometimes she would come to wake me up.
findings.evidenceJa: 寝坊した時、たまに起こされるコトもあった。
findings.governingReading: He remembers sometimes being woken when he overslept in the storehouse.
